name: Replit Agent
desc: Builds and deploys apps from plain-language descriptions
desc_zh: 用自然语言描述直接生成并部署应用
solves: An idea, and no environment to run it in. Agent handles planning through deployment — you talk, it writes, runs and hosts the app.
solves_zh: 只有想法，没有能跑起来的环境。Agent 从规划一路管到部署：你说，它负责写、跑和托管。
best_for: When you need something working and shareable today, and have no dev machine set up.
best_for_zh: 当你今天就要一个能跑、能分享的东西，却还没配好开发机。
notes: 官网已确认，标题「The Next Evolution in AI App Building Tools | Agent 4」。Agent 运行在 Replit IDE 内，故 form 记为 ide。
